verdicts.evidence: temporal_filter(np.asfortranarray(m)) for m (40,30,30): frames 0-3 and 37-39 equal the per-index np.median reference exactly, interior frames differ by up to 1.59 (loadmat-style transposed (H,W,T) view: 2.32); temporal_filter_patch on the F array differs by 1.59; the C-order result matches the reference to 0.0. Root cause confirmed: np.empty_like of an F-ordered array is F-ordered and out.reshape(n,-1) does not share memory with it, so the window==8 path writes into a copy. Reachability: process_fov instrumented on the synthetic FOV under defaults, whiten_traces=True and patch_local_filter=False+float32 hands temporal_filter / extract_footprints a C_CONTIGUOUS movie on every path; io.read_bin_mov, preprocess and pipeline never transpose, and no script in scripts/ or bench/ loads a .mat movie.
verdicts.severity_adjustment: S1 only for an external caller of the public function with a non-C layout. From process_fov the layout invariant holds on every path but is asserted nowhere, which is the rubric's S3 definition; recommend S3 unless the public API counts as a supported entry point (a one-line np.ascontiguousarray / order='C' in movmedian_time closes it either way).
